s6813: Will the driver of the truck carrying dangerous goods break the traffic rules by driving in the direction of the arrow?
s6814: According to subparagraph "c" of paragraph 1 of Article 19 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, the driver, or in the cases provided for in subparagraph "d" of paragraph 1 of Article 18 of this Law, the enterprise, must fix the following identification signs to the vehicles specified in this paragraph: "Dangerous goods": a rectangular orange plate measuring 400 × 300 mm with a black border 15 mm wide, fixed to the front and rear of a vehicle carrying such goods, and in the case of a tanker also on its sides (the lower part of the plate must show the United Nations number of the goods and the upper part the hazard identification number; they must be separated by a black horizontal line 15 mm thick crossing the plate at half its height). According to paragraphs 4.9.1–4.9.3 of Chapter 4 (Mandatory signs) of Annex 1 to the same Law, road signs 4.9.1–4.9.3 "Direction of travel for vehicles carrying dangerous goods" show the permitted direction of travel for vehicles carrying dangerous goods which, under the legislation of Georgia, must display the "Dangerous goods" identification sign: 4.9.1 – straight ahead, 4.9.2 – right, 4.9.3 – left.
s6815: According to paragraphs 4.9.1–4.9.3 of Chapter 4 (Mandatory signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road signs 4.9.1–4.9.3 "Direction of travel for vehicles carrying dangerous goods" show the permitted direction of travel for vehicles carrying dangerous goods which, under the legislation of Georgia, must display the "Dangerous goods" identification sign: 4.9.1 – straight ahead, 4.9.2 – right, 4.9.3 – left.
s6816: Within the area covered by which of these road signs is a U-turn not prohibited?
s6817: According to paragraph 7.3.1 of Chapter 7 (Information signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic and the Note to that paragraph, road sign 7.3.1 "U-turn place" marks a place for making a U-turn. Signs 7.3.1 and 7.3.2 are placed before the U-turn place or above it, or in advance with plate 8.1.1. These signs do not allow a left turn. According to paragraph 4.1.3 of Chapter 4 (Mandatory signs) of the same Annex and subparagraph "a" of the Note to that paragraph, road sign 4.1.3 "Turn left only" permits traffic only in the directions shown by the arrows, and signs that allow a left turn also allow a U-turn.
s6818: In which direction may the driver of a subcategory "D1" vehicle continue on this section of the motorway?
s6819: According to subparagraph "e" of paragraph 7 of Article 33 of the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, except in the cases set by this Law, outside built-up areas, and in built-up areas on sections of road where the appropriate sign allows speeds above 60 km/h, vehicles of subcategories "D1" and "D1E" may travel on all roads at no more than 80 km/h. According to paragraph 4.6 of Chapter 4 (Mandatory signs) of Annex 1 to the same Law, sign 4.6 "Minimum speed limit" sets the minimum speed for driving on the road. The sign applies after the sign, from the place where it stands to the nearest intersection, and in a built-up area with no intersection, to the end of the built-up area. According to paragraph 8.14 of Chapter 8 (Additional information signs (plates)) of the same Annex, plate 8.14 "Lane" shows the lane to which a sign or traffic light applies. The plate is placed above the lane.
s6823: What can be fitted to a milling-cutter ditch cleaner?
s6824: Scraper-type levellers can be fitted to a milling-cutter ditch cleaner.
s6828: What is used to repair and clean small irrigation or drainage networks?
s6829: Continuous-action ditch cleaners are used to repair and clean small irrigation or drainage networks.
s6830: How many types of tractor-mounted ditch cleaners are there?
s6831: There are three types of tractor-mounted ditch cleaners.
s6835: In soils of what density is a dragline excavator used?
s6836: A dragline excavator is used for work in soils of light and medium density categories.
s6839: In soils of what density is a grab excavator used?
s6840: A grab excavator is used for work in light-density soils.
s6841: How many drums does the winch of a grab excavator have?
s6842: A grab excavator has a three-drum winch.
